title: Bug: SessionStore shares one dict across all instances and expired sessions are never cleaned
body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/session_store.py`

`SessionStore` uses a mutable default argument (`sessions={}`), so all instances share the same session dict. `purge_expired()` never removes anything because it compares against the wrong clock.
### Expected
- two stores are independent
- `purge_expired(now)` drops sessions whose `expires_at <= now`
